description: European Ground Motion Service: GNSS model 2015-2020 (vector), Europe, 2-yearly, Jul. 2022 is a dataset listed in EEA SDI - geospatial data catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by European Environment Agency. The European Ground Motion Service (EGMS) is a component of the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. EGMS provides consistent, regular, standardised, harmonised and reliable information regarding natural and anthropogenic ground motion phenomena over the Copernicus Participating States and across national borders, with millimetre accuracy. Coverage: Europe. The publisher named on the listing is European Environment Agency. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read).
